The appeal path, quoted from POL-GEN-04

Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 0.00 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

The judge's explanation, as written

To both parties: the disputed charge is SGD 20.64 and the amount contested is SGD 3.00. This is a rider-filed ROUTE_DEVIATION dispute and the outcome is NO_ACTION — the charge stands and no money moves to either side. The gate. POL-RD-01 establishes a deviation only where the excess over the optimal route is BOTH greater than 20% of optimal AND greater than 0.8 km. The governing measurement is the GPS trace: gps_trace.trace_distance_km 14.39 km against the booked optimal of 12.0 km (trip record) is an excess of 2.39 km, or 19.92% of optimal. The trip record's 14.4 km is a rounded convenience copy of the same measurement and may not be cited for the threshold test; even on it the excess is exactly 20.0%, still not 'greater than 20%'. The absolute limb is met (2.39 km > 0.8 km), but both limbs must pass and the percentage limb does not. No route deviation is established, and POL-RD-01 directs NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip. Billing integrity. POL-RD-09(4) is the only money route that survives a failed establishment test. The fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02817) carries no ERP gantry lines, no tolls and no airport surcharge, and every line reconciles to meter arithmetic — SGD 3.80 base fare, 14.4 km at SGD 0.75/km (SGD 10.80), 18.7 min at SGD 0.28/min (SGD 5.24) and the SGD 0.80 platform fee, totalling SGD 20.64. There is no unmatched or phantom charge line, so nothing is refundable under POL-RD-09. The refund the rider asked for. The rider's advocate computed a POL-RD-02 refund of SGD 2.56 — recomputed fare SGD 18.08 (3.80 + 0.75 x 12.0 + 0.28 x 16.0 + 0.80, read with the fare breakdown's surge multiplier of 1.0), refund 20.64 - 18.08 = 2.56, payable SGD 2.60. That is correct as arithmetic but it is conditional on the establishment test being satisfied, and it is not. The SGD 2.60 is therefore not payable. (For completeness, the de minimis floor of SGD 0.50 and the 90% full-refund share would not have altered that figure had the gate been passed.) Exclusions. None applies. The chat log (EV-CHAT-02817) holds 0 messages, so there is no rider instruction capable of engaging POL-RD-04; neither pickup_amended_at nor dropoff_amended_at is set and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-05 cannot re-apply the threshold against amended endpoints; and vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not apply and 12.0 km remains the only optimal on the record. The driver's explanation. The driver's statement — 'Minor detour because of a road works sign' — asserts an external traffic cause. Under POL-RD-13 and POL-RD-03 that assertion is tested against the traffic advisory for this trip and nothing else. No advisory covers this trip: EV-ADVIS-02817-01 is MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT. The comparison cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08; it neither reduces the measured excess nor supplies an amended optimal. This is not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation, because the driver named no evidence ID for any advisory, so no exculpatory clause is invoked against a cited artifact. The statement is also not a measurement and cannot establish a deviation the numeric gate does not. Profile material. The excess is not MATERIAL (2.39 km is neither more than 50% of optimal nor more than 8.0 km), so POL-RD-06 is not engaged and no conduct referral arises; in any event the only counters that clause names give driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d of 0 over completed_trips_90d of 174, far below its 0.05 / 40-trip test, so no pattern would be established. No other profile field bears on the outcome. Trace integrity and escalation. The GPS trace is clean for policy purposes: 113 fixes, a 10-second sample interval, 100% coverage, no gaps and a maximum gap of 0.0 s. None of POL-RD-07(a)–(c) is met, so no independent corroboration is required and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires: the trip identifiers all match (TRP-02817); the timestamps are consistent; no exculpatory clause is invoked against a cited missing artifact; no refund computation arises to approach SGD 150.00; there is no mutually contradictory evidence of comparable strength; and no charge line lacks a counterpart. On confidence (POL-GEN-02(2)) the deciding fact — that the excess falls below the POL-RD-01 threshold — is carried by the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02817) and the trip record (EV-TRIP-02817), each at weight_multiplier 1.0, and the only impaired artifact is the missing advisory at 0.0, which carries no fact. Confidence is 0.90, comfortably above the 0.70 floor, so POL-RD-10(1) does not apply either. POL-GEN-03: NO_ACTION is party-relative. On this rider-filed dispute, payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00, so that state is left exactly as it is. Under POL-GEN-05 the monetary effect is nil, below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, and nothing is held. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

The trip record's 14.4 km is a rounded convenience copy of the same measurement and under POL-RD-01 may not be cited for the threshold test; the rider has not cited it.

evidence EV-GPS-02817, EV-TRIP-02817 · clauses POL-RD-01

kept The establishment test is not met on the field as published, and the rider does not pretend otherwise: the trace excess of 2.39 km clears the absolute limb (well above 0.8 km) but is 19.92% of the 12.0 km optimal, some 10 metres short of the 20% limb, so POL-RD-01's percentage test fails and no deviation is established. The rider does not ask the tribunal to read 19.92% as 'greater than 20%', and does not press a distance refund as of right.

evidence EV-GPS-02817, EV-TRIP-02817 · clauses POL-RD-01

POL-RD-03 therefore cannot be run, no closure-adjusted optimal can be produced, and under POL-RD-13 and POL-RD-08 an uncited traffic assertion neither reduces the measured excess nor supplies an amended route; the driver names no artifact and no clause at all.

evidence EV-ADVIS-02817-01, EV-GPS-02817 · clauses POL-RD-13, POL-RD-03, POL-RD-08, POL-GEN-02

kept Nothing on this record excludes any part of the measured excess. The chat log holds 0 messages, so there is no rider instruction capable of engaging POL-RD-04; neither pickup_amended_at nor dropoff_amended_at is set and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-05 does not re-apply the threshold against amended endpoints; and vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not apply and 12.0 km remains the only optimal on the record.

evidence EV-CHAT-02817, EV-TRIP-02817 · clauses POL-RD-04, POL-RD-05, POL-RD-12

kept If the tribunal finds the establishment test satisfied, the refund is arithmetic and is 2.56 before rounding: recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 12.0 + 0.28 x 16.0) x 1.0 — the surge multiplier read from the fare breakdown, which is where POL-RD-02 says it must be read — plus 0.80 platform fee, nil ERP, nil fixed surcharge, nil waiting fee, less nil promo, giving 18.08; refund = 20.64 - 18.08 = 2.56, payable rounded up to SGD 2.60.

evidence EV-FARE-02817, EV-TRIP-02817 · clauses POL-RD-02, POL-RD-01

kept That refund is neither de minimis nor full: 2.56 is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor, so this is not a NO_ACTION case on quantum, and it is 12.4% of the 20.64 charged, below the 90% share that would make it a FULL_REFUND; it is also far below the SGD 150 figure that forces escalation under POL-RD-10. On that arithmetic the rider's ask is a PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 2.60 out of the SGD 3.00 contested.

evidence EV-FARE-02817 · clauses POL-RD-02, POL-RD-10, POL-GEN-03

kept No corroboration burden beyond the trace attaches to the rider's claim under POL-RD-08: rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0 and rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, so the four-or-more claims / one-or-fewer substantiated combination that would require independent corroboration for a sub-30% excess is simply not present here.

evidence EV-RPROF-02817 · clauses POL-RD-08

kept If the tribunal cannot reach confidence of 0.70 or better on a NO_ACTION ruling, POL-RD-10(1) requires ESCALATE, and on an escalation under POL-GEN-03 the disputed SGD 3.00 is held rather than collected — a materially better position for the rider than a ruling that leaves the whole 20.64 charged. The margin is exactly the size that makes that confidence arguable: the gate turns on a 10-metre shortfall measured over 113 fixes sampled every 10 seconds with no gaps, and the platform's own two published figures for the same distance (14.39 km and 14.4 km) differ by 0.01 km.

evidence EV-GPS-02817, EV-TRIP-02817, EV-FARE-02817 · clauses POL-RD-10, POL-GEN-03

The driver advocate

kept The deviation gate has two limbs and the percentage limb fails. Under POL-RD-01 the governing measurement is gps_trace.trace_distance_km, which is 14.39 km against a booked optimal of 12.0 km, an excess of 2.39 km, or 19.92% of optimal. 19.92% is not 'greater than 20%', so no route deviation is ESTABLISHED, and POL-RD-01 directs NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip, save for the billing-integrity route under POL-RD-09(4) which is not in play here.

evidence EV-GPS-02817, EV-TRIP-02817 · clauses POL-RD-01

On either figure the percentage limb fails.

evidence EV-GPS-02817, EV-TRIP-02817 · clauses POL-RD-01

kept I concede the absolute limb: 2.39 km does exceed the 0.8 km floor in POL-RD-01. But POL-RD-01 requires BOTH tests to pass, and only one does. A single satisfied limb cannot carry the rider's case, and the missing limb, the percentage limb, cannot be supplied from anything on this record.

evidence EV-GPS-02817, EV-TRIP-02817 · clauses POL-RD-01

evidence EV-GPS-02817, EV-TRIP-02817, EV-DPROF-02817 · clauses POL-RD-01, POL-RD-06

evidence EV-GPS-02817 · clauses POL-RD-07, POL-RD-10

kept The initial burden is the rider's and it is not discharged. POL-RD-08 requires the rider to show, citing evidence, an excess meeting the POL-RD-01 threshold. The only artifacts that measure this trip, the trace and the booking optimal, put the excess at 2.39 km and 19.92%, below the threshold, so the burden never shifts to the driver and the driver need not reach any exculpatory clause at all.

evidence EV-GPS-02817, EV-TRIP-02817 · clauses POL-RD-08

kept The only route to money that survives a failed establishment test is a pass-through or billing-integrity correction under POL-RD-09, and there is nothing to correct. The fare ledger shows no ERP gantry lines, no tolls and no airport surcharge, and no charge line lacking a counterpart in the trip record: it is meter arithmetic on 14.4 km at $0.75 per km plus 18.7 minutes at $0.28 per minute plus the $0.80 platform fee. evidence EV-FARE-02817 · clauses POL-RD-09

evidence EV-FARE-02817 · clauses POL-GEN-03

To both parties: the disputed charge is SGD 20.64 and the amount contested is SGD 3.00. This is a rider-filed ROUTE_DEVIATION dispute and the outcome is NO_ACTION — the charge stands and no money moves to either side. The gate. POL-RD-01 establishes a deviation only where the excess over the optimal route is BOTH greater than 20% of optimal AND greater than 0.8 km. The governing measurement is the GPS trace: gps_trace.trace_distance_km 14.39 km against the booked optimal of 12.0 km (trip record) is an excess of 2.39 km, or 19.92% of optimal. The trip record's 14.4 km is a rounded convenience copy of the same measurement and may not be cited for the threshold test; even on it the excess is exactly 20.0%, still not 'greater than 20%'. The absolute limb is met (2.39 km > 0.8 km), but both limbs must pass and the percentage limb does not. No route deviation is established, and POL-RD-01 directs NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip. Billing integrity. POL-RD-09(4) is the only money route that survives a failed establishment test. The fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02817) carries no ERP gantry lines, no tolls and no airport surcharge, and every line reconciles to meter arithmetic — SGD 3.80 base fare, 14.4 km at SGD 0.75/km (SGD 10.80), 18.7 min at SGD 0.28/min (SGD 5.24) and the SGD 0.80 platform fee, totalling SGD 20.64. There is no unmatched or phantom charge line, so nothing is refundable under POL-RD-09. The refund the rider asked for. That is correct as arithmetic but it is conditional on the establishment test being satisfied, and it is not. The SGD 2.60 is therefore not payable. The chat log (EV-CHAT-02817) holds 0 messages, so there is no rider instruction capable of engaging POL-RD-04; neither pickup_amended_at nor dropoff_amended_at is set and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-05 cannot re-apply the threshold against amended endpoints; and vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not apply and 12.0 km remains the only optimal on the record. The rider's request to escalate on confidence grounds does not fire: the deciding facts (the trace distance and the booked optimal) are carried by the unimpaired GPS trace and trip record, each at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the confidence cap is 1.0 and the ruling is well above the 0.70 floor; POL-RD-10(5) and (7) are also not engaged, as the driver cited no advisory identifier and the rider's own figures concede the gate fails. Under POL-GEN-03, NO_ACTION leaves the state exactly as it is: fare_breakdown.payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00 stand, and the disputed SGD 3.00 is not refunded. The monetary effect is zero, below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so no amount is held for reviewer release.
Both parties agree on the decisive arithmetic, and so do I. POL-RD-01 establishes a deviation only where the excess distance is BOTH greater than 20% of the optimal route AND greater than 0.8 km. The governing measurement is gps_trace.trace_distance_km on EV-GPS-02817: 14.39 km against the 12.0 km optimal on EV-TRIP-02817. That is an excess of 2.39 km — it clears the absolute limb (2.39 > 0.8 km), but it is 19.92% of optimal, which is not 'greater than 20%'. The percentage limb fails, and because POL-RD-01 requires both limbs, no deviation is established. Using the trip record's rounded 14.4 km would give exactly 20.0%, still not 'greater than 20%'; POL-RD-01 in any event forbids citing that rounded copy for the threshold test. The margin is small (about 10 m over a 14.39 km trace), but both of the platform's own distance figures fall on the same side of the gate, so the result is not genuinely in doubt. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes: 113 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gaps and a maximum gap of 0.0 s, so POL-RD-07(a) to (c) are not met, no independent corroboration is required, and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged. No exculpatory clause changes the result and none is needed: the chat log EV-CHAT-02817 holds 0 messages (no POL-RD-04 rider instruction); neither pickup nor dropoff was amended and amended_optimal_distance_km is null (POL-RD-05 inapplicable); and vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL (POL-RD-12 inapplicable), so 12.0 km remains the only optimal on the record. The driver's counterparty note — 'Minor detour because of a road works sign' — is an uncited traffic-cause assertion. No traffic advisory covers this trip: EV-ADVIS-02817-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run and, under POL-RD-08 and POL-RD-13, the assertion neither reduces the measured excess nor supplies an amended optimal. Because the driver names no evidence ID for any advisory, POL-RD-13(1) treats this as a gap in the bundle rather than the POL-RD-10(5) contradiction, so it does not escalate the case. No billing-integrity correction is available under POL-RD-09(4): the fare ledger EV-FARE-02817 shows no ERP gantry lines, no tolls and no airport surcharge, and every line is meter arithmetic on the driven distance and time (14.4 km at $0.75/km plus 18.7 min at $0.28/min plus the $0.80 platform fee, surge multiplier 1.0 read from the fare breakdown). I have considered the rider's escalation request under POL-RD-10(1). The deciding fact — the 14.39 km trace on EV-GPS-02817 against the 12.0 km optimal on EV-TRIP-02817 — is carried by two independent weight-1.0 artifacts, so my confidence is capped at 1.0 and I am well above the 0.70 floor; POL-RD-10(1) is therefore not engaged. No other limb of POL-RD-10 fires either: identifiers match across all three artifacts (TRP-02817), no timestamps conflict or run backwards, the refund caps are nowhere near, and there is no mutually contradictory evidence of comparable strength — both sides read the same arithmetic to the same result. The rider's conditional refund computation (recomputed fare 18.08, refund 2.56, payable 2.60) is correct arithmetic but is never reached, because POL-RD-02 only runs once a deviation is established and it is not. Ruling: NO_ACTION. The rider's claim is not supported by the evidence and the present state stands — the charge on EV-FARE-02817 (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) is left exactly as it is. No amount is refunded, no driver compensation is payable, and no clause produces a referral (POL-RD-06(c) needs a MATERIAL deviation and a driver pattern, neither of which exists; POL-RD-09(4) finds no phantom line). The disputed SGD 3.00 remains charged; the monetary effect (zero) is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold, and this ruling is provisional with the POL-GEN-04 appeal route available to either party.
